cells.gaps: What the BMI-WFS system will record and where it will be held are not stated, and no fact says it is live; no commune other than Bangui is named. The paper fact is one trader's account of Bangui in December 2020 and is not a statement about local governments at large; plan and finance are not stated.
cells.note: An agreement signed in December 2025 for the capital alone is a system being prepared. Stage 3 needs a system live in local governments outside the capital.
